description.value: Sirka Takeout is an Indian restaurant in Surrey specializing in bold, authentic regional cuisine rooted in Punjabi culinary traditions, created by Chef Kanwardeep and Chef Baldeep. The menu spans chaat street food, tandoori kebabs, Indo-Chinese dishes, and rich curries. Its takeout-focused format and broad menu — including many vegetarian options — make it a practical and flavourful stop for cyclists moving through Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sirka Takeout is an Indian restaurant operating from two Surrey locations; the OSM address (7182 120 Street) is listed as a secondary location on the website's menus page, while the primary location shown throughout the site is 6468 King George Blvd Unit 1B. The OSM cuisine tag 'pizza' is incorrect — the menu is entirely Indian food with no pizza items. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website, but takeout service and extensive vegetarian menu options are clearly evidenced.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'pizza' but the restaurant serves Indian food exclusively — no pizza appears anywhere on the menu.
OSM name 'Sirka Gourmet Takeout' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Sirka Takeout'.
OSM address (7182 120 Street) is listed as a secondary location on the website's menus page; the website's primary address is 6468 King George Blvd Unit 1B, Surrey, BC V3W 4Z3.
Phone number +1 (604) 592-9999 comes from the website; OSM tags contain no phone number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active Indian takeout restaurant with online ordering and a broad menu including many vegetarian options; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Surrey.
